zh-CN.name: REA MCP
zh-CN.summary: REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务：分析本地二进制、JavaScript、托管代码与浏览器；需兼容 Node.js，分析引擎按任务另行配置。
zh-CN.description: 固定 rea-agents@6.4.0 的本地 stdio 服务，CLI 与 MCP 共用一个发布包，无独立桌面 GUI。Node.js 要求 ^22.19.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26.0.0。服务登记不自动安装 Ghidra、Hopper、IDA、JEB、Java、浏览器或 Android 工具；商用引擎需单独许可。仅分析获授权目标，运行、附加调试、修改文件及设备操作需明确授权。macOS 已验证无目标启动、握手和 170 项工具列表；Windows/Linux 与具体分析任务未实测。条目为独立社区收录，不代表上游背书或完整安全审计。

en-US.name: REA MCP
en-US.summary: REA reverse-engineering MCP service for local binaries, JavaScript, managed code and browsers; requires compatible Node.js and task-specific analysis providers.
en-US.description: Local stdio service pinned to rea-agents@6.4.0. CLI and MCP share one release package; there is no standalone desktop GUI. Requires Node.js ^22.19.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26.0.0. Listing does not install Ghidra, Hopper, IDA, JEB, Java, browsers or Android tools; commercial engines require separate licenses. Analyze authorized targets only; execution, debugger attachment, file mutation and device actions require explicit authorization. Target-free startup, handshake and a 170-tool inventory were verified on macOS; Windows/Linux and actual analyses were not exercised. Independent community listing, without upstream endorsement or a complete security audit.
